audited_paths: apps/craft-anything-cli/src/tool_args.rs: --json parses only supplied JSON parameter object
crates/engine/src/settings.rs: CRAFT_ANYTHING_CONFIG_DIR takes precedence over portable/user configuration
crates/engine/src/plugins.rs: install loads only configured/cached plugin definitions; defaults and isolated config have no plugins
crates/engine/src/tools/web_tools.rs: web_recording_show reads a capped local HAR, calls inspect_har and builds evidence
crates/analysis/src/web_har.rs: in-memory parsing, grouping, outline/redaction, no process/network/model call

execution_boundary.environment: explicit allowlist with fresh HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, TEMP, TMP, and CRAFT_ANYTHING_CONFIG_DIR
execution_boundary.project: no --project, so no existing project/evidence or project settings are loaded
execution_boundary.stdin: closed empty bytes, all data via synthetic files and JSON parameters
execution_boundary.limitation: Static call-path review and environment isolation do not constitute an OS sandbox. Outbound networking is not independently blocked or instrumented. The chosen handler contains no network or subprocess calls.

licenses.brand: No ArtCraft fonts, logos, UI assets or marks reused
